instruction: Turn off Chrome's smooth scrolling to enable immediate, non-animated scrolling.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to disable the smooth scrolling experiment in Chrome by navigating to chrome://flags and setting the 'Smooth Scrolling' flag to disabled. The evaluator checks that 'smooth-scrolling' is NOT present in the enabled experiments list. Similar difficulty to the original task which requires disabling UI refresh experiments.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable smooth scrolling
Getter extracts the correct state from Chrome Local State file (browser.enabled_labs_experiments)
Metric correctly checks that 'smooth-scrolling' is NOT in the enabled experiments list
Expected value is semantically correct (experiment_name: smooth-scrolling)
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted and reloaded
Getter handles experiment name format correctly by stripping @suffix (e.g., smooth-scrolling@1)
Metric parameter handling is correct - directly accesses expected.get('experiment_name') without incorrect .get('rules')
Edge cases handled: returns empty list on errors, supports multiple OS platforms
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (disable smooth scrolling) and evaluator checks exactly that
